name: PostgreSQL — Patroni, writes
summary: TCP 5432 to whichever node is the leader, found by asking Patroni.
notes: Patroni answers GET /primary with 200 on the leader and 503 everywhere else, so the health check does the routing: every replica is simply down for this pool, and a failover moves traffic without changing anything here. Traffic goes to 5432 while the check goes to Patroni's REST API on 8008.
